items.t: Air suspension sags or compressor runs nonstop
items.job: Replace leaking air springs and air compressor (or convert to coil springs)
items.note: A single air spring is much cheaper. CarComplaints owners report about $2,300 to $3,800 for full repairs; a coil-spring conversion kit is often the cheapest long-term fix.

items.t: Cam phaser and timing chain knock
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides, tensioners and cam phasers
items.note: The job is long because the front of the engine comes apart. A new oil pump is often added at the same time.

items.t: Spark plug blown out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with an insert and replace plug and coil
items.note: Price is for one cylinder. If the head is too damaged and must be replaced, the cost is much higher.

items.t: Spark plugs break off during replacement
items.job: Replace spark plugs, extracting any broken plugs
items.note: Each broken plug that needs extracting adds time. CarComplaints owners report costs from a few hundred dollars to over $2,000.

items.t: Power running boards stick or stop deploying
items.job: Replace one power running board motor
items.note: Price is for one side. Seized hinges or a rusted board add to the bill.

items.t: Rear liftgate glass shatters
items.job: Replace rear liftgate glass
items.note: Check your insurance glass coverage first.

items.t: Air suspension warning light with no real fault
items.job: Diagnose air suspension and replace control module
items.note: Rule out a real air leak before buying a module.

items.t: Throttle sticks on cold mornings
items.job: Install PCV service kit and clean throttle body

items.t: Power accessories stop working after the key is off
items.job: Replace battery saver relay

items.t: Harsh or erratic 10-speed shifts
items.job: Transmission software update and adaptive relearn
items.note: If the valve body or clutches are damaged, repair costs rise to several thousand dollars.

items.t: Center touchscreen freezes or goes black
items.job: Infotainment software update or reset
items.note: If the display module itself fails, parts cost several hundred dollars more.
